PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday OCTOBER 10, 2019
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.

8. Public Hearings
8A. Conditional Use Permit 09-02 Time Extension No. 1
SBA Monarch Towers III, LLC, Applicant
A request for a ten-year time extension for the operation of an existing major communication facility located at 2121 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 09-02 Time Extension No. 1 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review.
Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Site Plan Review 19-010 / Conditional Use Permit 19-009
Irwin Partners Architects, Applicant
A request to construct an assisted living facility located at the terminus of Town Center Drive, south of Rancho Vista Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Site Plan Review 19-010 and Conditional Use Permit 19-009 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review.
Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Conditional Use Permit 19-011
J & G Gonzalez 2 Enterprises, Inc., Applicant
A request to establish a Type 20 (off-sale beer and wine) Alcoholic Beverage Control License for a grocery store use with sales of tobacco within an existing tenant space located at 3020 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 19-011 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. Conditional Use Permit 19-014
Greenberg Farrow, Applicant
A request to establish a Type 20 (Off-Sale Beer and Wine) Alcoholic Beverage Control License for a grocery store use to be located approximately 500 feet south of Avenue S and west of 47th Street East/State Route 138.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 19-014 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
